meta.title: Playvo booking assistant: suggestion accuracy test cases (US-5.4, SRS specific objective 4)

groups.tuning: Cases the rule-based fallback may be tuned against.
groups.held_out: Written before any tuning of the fallback (commit 626f6c4) and never used to tune it. The reviewer found they are not independent of the Sprint 4 parser work (19/23 with the parser at 1dc4882), so they overstate accuracy on new phrasings.
groups.unseen_r1: 45 phrasings the reviewer wrote without the developer seeing them (round 1, Stage 3 review): 30/45 on the fallback at a202957. They are known now, so from here on they count as tuning material, not as a blind measure; a fresh blind set will measure accuracy honestly.
groups.blind_r2: 68 phrasings (39 Arabic, 17 English, 12 Arabizi or mixed) the reviewer wrote blind, from this fixture and meta only, at ea90d84 (Stage 4 review): 61/68 (89.7%) on the fallback there. They are known now, so from here on they count as tuning material, not as a blind measure. A case marked debatable has an expectation the reviewer considered open to dispute.
groups.v2: Assistant v2 cases written by the developer for the v2 features (tuning material, not a blind measure): spans of days, lists ranked by rating, price or distance, follow-ups in one conversation (turns before the final query, with the state carried over), quick replies (option_id) and a shared location (latitude/longitude), and the questions around a booking. They also expect the intent and the span of days (period, a PeriodParser name); venue is the top suggestion.

meta.scoring: A case is correct only when the outcome matches (the expected venue, no match, or a request for the missing details) and the sport, date, hour, and the city or area when one is expected, are all understood as expected.

outcomes.suggestion: The assistant suggests the expected venue.
outcomes.no_match: Everything is understood but no available slot fits, so the no-match reply is given.
outcomes.needs_details: The sport, day or hour is missing, so the assistant asks for it.
outcomes.not_covered: The player named a city or area with no venues, so the assistant says it is not covered instead of suggesting a venue elsewhere.
outcomes.needs_location: v2: the player asked for venues near them without sharing a location, so the assistant asks for it.
outcomes.not_offered: v2: the sport named is not offered by any venue yet.
outcomes.answer: v2: a question answered without a search (prices, working hours, policies, small talk); for prices the venue is the cheapest one.
